basics.name: Kokes Projects
basics.description: The shared visual system for Kokes Projects: small web apps, developer tools and personal sites. Neon lime on charcoal and white, set in Poppins and Inter.
basics.audience: Developers and tech-savvy people using small web apps, tools and side projects.
basics.voice: Direct, concise and developer-friendly. Lead with the point, use technical terms when they are the most precise word, and put code in monospace. Dry humor is welcome in empty states and 404 pages, never in errors.
writingDo: Lead with the point and keep sentences short
Use technical terms when they are the most precise word
Format code, commands, keys and file names in monospace
Say what went wrong and how to fix it in error messages
writingDont: Joke in error messages or destructive confirmations
Over-explain basics to a technical audience

imagery.style: Product screenshots and real UI over stock photography. Crop tight, frame with a 1px border-role outline and radius lg. Dark UI captures pair best with the lime accent.

notes.button: Pill-shaped (radius full) for buttons and tags. Primary is a lime fill with near-black text.
notes.card: Radius lg (16px). Prefer a 1px border over a shadow; use shadow only for floating elements.
notes.nav: Mark the current page with the link color and a 2px underline, not color alone.

accessibility.focusStyle: 2px solid outline in the link role color, offset 2px

do: Use lime only as a fill (with near-black text) or as text/icons on dark backgrounds
Keep lime to a few high-signal elements per screen: the primary action, highlights, active states
dont: Put lime text, icons or borders on white or light surfaces; they are unreadable (1.2:1)
Use lime to mean success; use the success role
Introduce other brand hues; secondary and accent are the grey and lime scales

do: Use Poppins for headings and short display text only; set paragraphs and UI in Inter
dont: Use Poppins for body copy or below the lg step

do: Keep Lucide's default 2px stroke at every size
Use pill (radius full) buttons and tags; cards and panels use radius lg
